threads.body: Add `inline = false`. I think that currently when instrumentation module has a mix of inline and non-inline advice we treat it as a non-indy instrumentation. To allow using inlined advice we strip the `inline = false` then. I think for v3 we probably should remove the bit the strips `inline = false` and let the instrumentation fail when inline and non-inline advice are mixed.

threads.body: [General] This applies metadata for the entire `Table.batch` call to every `Multi` RPC span. HBase's `AsyncProcess` partitions actions by region server and retries only failed subsets, so a given RPC may contain fewer actions—and even a different homogeneous operation mix—than the original list. Multi-region/retry spans will therefore report an inflated `db.operation.batch.size` and may have the wrong operation name. Derive these values from the actions in the actual `Multi` request (or emit one logical batch span), and cover a batch split across regions.

threads.body: [General] The implementation now derives metadata from each actual `MultiRequest`, but the PR description still says it instruments `HTable.batch(...)`, carries metadata through the context, and guarantees the table’s name/size mapping for the full submitted action list. Those claims are no longer true when HBase partitions a logical batch into multiple RPCs: each span reports only its request subset. Please update the PR description and behavior table to document the per-RPC semantics introduced here.

replies.body: Updated the PR description to document that metadata is derived from each actual MultiRequest. The behavior table now describes actions per request, and the text explains region-server partitioning and subset retries.
